topic.title: Why a billionaire CEO pays himself a one-dollar salary: salary is taxed when paid, share growth only when sold

cta: Would you take the dollar? Comment
title: A billionaire's payday: one dollar. Here's why 🤫
description:
Why would someone worth billions take a one-dollar salary?
A salary is taxed when it is paid; shares that grow are not taxed until they are sold. An illustrative $50 million salary at an assumed 37% top tax rate, next to the same value left in shares growing at an assumed 7% a year, computed. No real person or company.
